library: Cinderline Components maintenance library (synthetic teaching corpus)
note: Original fictional documents; sections and sentences are already parsed. No real manual, plant or value.

sections.heading: Hydraulic unit
sentences: Change the hydraulic filter on the M7 press every 250 operating hours or sooner if the indicator shows red.
Set the relief valve to 180 bar with the pump warm and the ram at top dead centre.
Record the relief valve setting and the filter change in the press log after any pump work.

sections.heading: Die change
sentences: Tighten the die clamp bolts to 95 Nm in a cross pattern before the first stroke.
Run two single strokes at inching speed and check that the die sits flat on the bolster.

sections.heading: Hydraulic unit
sentences: Change the hydraulic filter on the M7 press every 200 operating hours or sooner if the indicator shows red.
Set the relief valve to 180 bar with the pump warm and the ram at top dead centre.
Record the relief valve setting and the filter change in the press log after any pump work.

sections.heading: Die change
sentences: Tighten the die clamp bolts to 95 Nm in a cross pattern before the first stroke.
Run two single strokes at inching speed and check that the die sits flat on the bolster.

sections.heading: Hydraulic unit
sentences: Change the hydraulic filter on the M8 press every 300 operating hours and after any oil top-up.
Set the relief valve to 150 bar and lock the adjuster with the red cap.

sections.heading: Die change
sentences: Tighten the M8 die clamp bolts to 120 Nm, then recheck them after ten strokes.
The M8 ram stroke length is 417 mm, so use the long die spacers from rack B.

sections.heading: Relief valves
sentences: The relief valve setting protects the pump, and the correct setting differs between the M7 press and the M8 press.
Always read the setting from the current press manual, never from a label or from memory.

sections.heading: Filters
sentences: Hydraulic filter change intervals depend on the press model, the oil grade and the running hours.

sections.heading: Proposal
sentences: Raise the M7 press relief valve setting to 200 bar to reduce stalls on thick blanks.
This proposal has not been reviewed by engineering and must not be applied on the shop floor.

sections.heading: Before entering the tooling area
sentences: Stop the press, switch off the main disconnect and fit your personal lock and tag.
Bleed the hydraulic accumulator until the gauge reads zero before you reach past the guard.

sections.heading: Clearing a jam
sentences: Before clearing a jam on any press, lock out the main disconnect with your own padlock.
Clearing a jam also needs the accumulator bled to zero and a second person watching the guard.

sections.heading: Test procedure
sentences: The overpressure test holds the M7 hydraulic circuit at 220 bar for ten minutes with the ram blocked.
Only engineering staff may run the overpressure test, and the test rig must be signed off first.

sections.heading: Coolant
sentences: Keep the L2 coolant concentration between 5 and 7 percent, measured with the refractometer.
Top up with premixed coolant only, never with plain water from the wash station.

sections.heading: Chuck
sentences: Inspect the L2 chuck jaws for chips and burrs at the start of every shift.

sections.heading: Coolant
sentences: Keep the L2 coolant concentration between 6 and 8 percent, measured with the refractometer.
Top up with premixed coolant only, never with plain water from the wash station.

sections.heading: Chuck
sentences: Inspect the L2 chuck jaws for chips and burrs at the start of every shift.

sections.heading: Routine
sentences: Check the L2 lathe coolant concentration weekly and log the refractometer reading on the machine card.

sections.heading: Temporary instruction
sentences: Check L2 coolant concentration at every shift start until the new pump is fitted.

sections.heading: Belt tension
sentences: Check C4 belt tension monthly by pressing the belt at midspan; deflection should be 12 mm.
Adjust both take-up screws by equal turns so the belt tracks in the centre of the pulleys.

sections.heading: Excessive vibration during run-up
sentences: If the conveyor vibrates hard during run-up, check the motor mount bolts for looseness first.
Next check coupling alignment with a straight edge and replace the coupling insert if it is cracked.

sections.heading: Unloader valve
sentences: Seal kit QX-417 fits the K1 unloader valve; replace all four O-rings together.
Torque the unloader cover screws to 12 Nm and leak-test with soapy water at 7 bar.

sections.heading: Routine
sentences: Drain condensate from the K1 receiver tank at the end of every shift and note the volume.

sections.heading: Every shift
sentences: Test the light curtain with the test rod and confirm the press stops before starting production.
Walk around the press and confirm that all guards are closed and no tools lie on the bolster.

sections.heading: Every shift
sentences: Test the light curtain with the test rod and log the result on the South shift sheet.
Check that the two-hand control buttons respond together and that the emergency stop latches.

sections.heading: Guards
sentences: Never bypass an interlocked guard on the M7 or M8 press, even for a single test stroke.
Report a damaged guard to the shift lead and tag the press out of service immediately.

sections.heading: Before work
sentences: Contractors sign in at the gatehouse and receive a written permit before touching any machine.
Hydraulic work by contractors needs a permit countersigned by the maintenance lead.
